fieldValues.title: P5: Distribution
fieldValues.summary: Splits Repository's ~790 lines into layout, manifest, travelling form and source documents, each with its own bridging prose (ruling B); moves JSON Store and slices to sit behind the travelling-form concept. Receives Blueprint and Protocol from P4 under ruling R2 once P4 lands. Concepts getting prose: Package, Repository, Travelling form, Lineage and provenance.
fieldValues.body: Landed by PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/845 (auto-merge armed, green on push). Repository split into Layout (existing mechanism, now grouping the root-layout example, File naming and the .srs-marker invariant), a new Manifest mechanism (RepositoryManifest/PackageRef/InstanceIndexEntry/RelationsChecksumEntry/SourceAnchor shapes, Relations storage, Schema conventions), the existing Travelling form concept (receives Archive format, Import/re-import semantics, SourceReference additions alongside its existing JSON Store/ext:slices content), and a new Source documents mechanism (SourceDocument/SourceDocumentIndexEntry shapes, the sidecar example). Local `precedes` chains rebuilt inside each group plus one top-level chain over Repository's seven direct children. Distribution's own Part description rewritten (it named a retired 'Reference' concept and omitted Repository/Blueprint/Protocol/Registry). Blueprint and Protocol (received from P4 under ruling R2) already carried self-describing prose; no change needed. A second commit fixed an RFC-042 [R9] violation caught by render-invariants.mjs: invariants need a concept contains-parent, not a mechanism, so 14 invariants were re-parented to the Repository concept directly. No memberOrder change: the read-through's divergence table names no Distribution-level reorder, and this PR rebased onto the build.414 pin (srs-rust#1131) regardless.
